rows.description: I look at the other children and wonder who will be my friend. I feel shy and curious. A wise teacher pairs children for an activity so friendships can begin easily.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: dependence, trust
related mind states: shyness, curiosity, awe

rows.description: My stomach twists when she laughs with the new girl. I want to say I miss her, not sulk or steal her back. Sulking and spreading rumours about the newcomer only pushes her further away.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, comfort, fear, guilt, insecurity, manipulation
paired view exists: Receiver (S631)
related mind states: amusement, jealousy

rows.description: I fear being replaced and start clinging, checking who she sits with. Wise: tell her plainly I feel left out and ask for one plan just us. Clinging and testing her loyalty makes her feel trapped.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, comfort, guilt, insecurity, jealousy, manipulation
related mind states: fear

rows.description: My friend acts cold since I made a new friend, and I feel guilty and cornered. Kind action: reassure her, keep our special time, and invite her in. Dropping the new friend or hiding her is not needed.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, comfort, fear, guilt, insecurity, manipulation
paired view exists: Actor (S629)
related mind states: guilt, jealousy

rows.description: I like the new friend but feel like a traitor to my old one. I can hold both friendships, tell my old friend she still matters, and not hide things. Lying about where I was makes it worse.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, comfort, fear, insecurity, jealousy, manipulation
related mind states: guilt

rows.description: I am the newcomer and sense my new friend's old friend dislikes me. I stay friendly, do not force her to choose, and give it time. Trying to win by making her look bad backfires.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, comfort, fear, guilt, jealousy, manipulation
related mind states: insecurity

rows.description: I see that friends can have other friends, and being happy for her costs me little. I say hi to the new girl and suggest a game for three. This maturity shows up as generosity, not as pretending I feel nothing.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: comfort, fear, guilt, insecurity, jealousy, manipulation
related mind states: joy

rows.description: My mum notices I am quiet and says friendships shift and stretch, and that she is here. Feeling heard helps me see it is not the end. Being told just ignore it leaves me alone with the hurt.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, fear, guilt, insecurity, jealousy, manipulation
related mind states: hurt

rows.description: I treat her like my property and get angry when she plays with others. Possessive love feels like caring but it shrinks her. Real friendship lets her breathe and trusts she will come back.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, comfort, fear, guilt, insecurity, jealousy
related mind states: affection, anger, trust, relief from stress

rows.description: I say fine, go play with her, but keep score of every time she chose others. Better to say the hurt out loud once, calmly. Silent resentment grows and slowly turns into cruelty.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, comfort, fear, guilt, insecurity, jealousy
related mind states: calm, resentment, hurt
